name: nemerle
description: Nemerle for VS Code and VSCodium: highlighting, diagnostics, outline and folding through nemerle-lsp, with grammar and space blocks parsed by Nitra.

nemerle.languageServer.path.description: A nemerle-lsp to use instead of the one in this extension (a launcher, or a nemerle-lsp.exe that runs on dotnet).

nemerle.dotnet.path.description: The dotnet command that runs the language server (default: dotnet on PATH). Needs the .NET 10 runtime.

nemerle.languageServer.references.description: Optional .NET reference assembly directory passed as --references.

nemerle.languageServer.log.description: Optional log file for the server.

nemerle.languageServer.sourceRoot.description: Root directory for file module paths (default: the workspace folder).

nemerle.languageServer.fileNameNamespace.description: A file's namespace is its file name only (-file-name-namespaces).
